identifier.value: Zain Mobile Voice and Data Plans

product.name: Zain Mobile Voice and Data Plans
product.description: Prepaid and postpaid mobile plans providing voice calls, mobile data, messaging, and related add-on packages for individual subscribers, including visitor and flexible plans.

product.name: Zain 5G Mobile Network
product.description: A cellular network service providing mobile voice and high-speed data connectivity over 5G and other supported network technologies across Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Zain Home 5G
product.description: Fixed-wireless home internet delivered through Zain’s 5G network and a compatible router, providing broadband connectivity without a wired fiber installation.

product.name: Zain Fiber Home
product.description: Fixed broadband internet delivered over fiber-optic infrastructure through prepaid and postpaid home plans, with high-speed and unlimited-use options.

product.name: International Roaming
product.description: Mobile connectivity services for Zain subscribers traveling outside Saudi Arabia, including roaming voice, data, and call-receiving packages in regional and global destinations.

product.name: Zain GeForce NOW
product.description: A cloud gaming service that streams supported PC games from Zain’s gaming cloud to compatible computers, mobile devices, Macs, and other supported screens.
